messages:
maria: planning a cautious rollout to increase 'eco-route' weight from 30% -> 50% for non-enterprise tenants. want preview + cohort gating + autosafe revert. not flipping live.

alex: agree. we should use config-preview and bake telemetry before any enforce. can we tag previews with owner + preview_id?

maria: yep. payload will include meta: owner and preview_id. sample plan: start global sample 1.5% (prv-61555), wait for signal, then a deterministic 10-tenant cohort at 10% enforce. snippet: ```json
{
  "route": "eco-route",
  "weight": 0.5,
  "preview": {"id": "prv-61555", "sample_rate": 0.015, "enforce": false, "scope": "global"},
  "meta": {"owner": "maria"}
}
```

jess: telemetry must expose p50/p95/p99, error_rate, and cost_per_token with preview_id tag. also add a request-volume floor; small samples are noisy.

sam: suggest thresholds: min_volume=600 per 30m, p95_delta <= 12% (relative), err_rate_delta <= 0.4pp, cost_delta <= 20%. if any breach, auto-revert.

alex: and implement a two-part alert: one for signal breach, one for insufficient volume (so we don't get paged on noisy data).

maria: runbook draft: 1) create preview (prv-61555) 2) wait 30m or until volume floor 600 3) manual check, if ok promote to enforced 10% deterministic cohort for 30m 4) if still ok, increase to 50% commit over 2h with steps (10% -> 25% -> 50%).

sre-oncall: include auto_revert rules: revert if p95>+20% OR err>+0.8pp OR cost>+40% in 15m window. will watch panels during scale. page list: oncall->eng-platform->maria.

jess: UI suggestions: show the preview badge on the route page, a stream of preview metrics, and a compact promote/abort action. show both absolute and delta views side-by-side.

alex: API detail: support preview.scope = {"tenant_ids": ["t-A", "t-B"]} or preview.scope = {"hash_prefix": 10} for deterministic bucketing. important for stable comparisons.

maria: we will use sample global first, then deterministic tenant list for the 10% step. add meta.tag = "eco-cost-experiment" to metrics.

ops-bot: preliminary smoke for prv-61555: run synthetic 1k reqs -> p95 +4%, err +0.03pp, cost +6%. no auto-revert triggered.

sam: looks safe so far. remember metric smoothing (rolling median) to avoid reacting to one-off spikes.

alex: one more guard: when promoting from preview to enforced cohort, lock config_id so only the promote flow can change it for 30m. avoids race with other edits.

maria: agreed. will set a short-lived edit lock during promotion. scheduling this for 11:00 PT. tagging @sre-oncall for watch and ack.

sre-oncall: ack. will post revert command in incident channel if we need to abort: revert_preview("prv-61555"). will runbook the exact steps in ops-runbook doc.

jess: after we finish, let's capture a small postmortem artifact: snapshot of baseline -> preview -> enforced metrics for audit. add link back to the config change.

maria: done. thanks team. will update console mockups to include promote/abort + owner tag + cohort trace link.
